blocks.orig: The Gnu Mara River Camp is located in the northern Serengeti in Kogatende, just a 5-minute drive from the famous Mara River, where wildebeests and zebras cross during their migration into the Masai Mara. The camp is open every year from July to mid-November, so guests can experience this unique spectacle first-hand. The camp’s facilities are of a high standard with eight tents (including one family tent) boasting ensuite facilities such as flush toilets, hot water, 24-hour solar power, and great views of the savannah. A dining tent, lounge and bar with a fireplace are available for relaxing closings of exciting safari days.
blocks.html: In Kogatende in the northern Serengeti, only a 5-minute drive from the famous Mara River, you find The Gnu Mara River Camp. This is where wildebeests and zebras cross the river on their migration into the Masai Mara. Each year the camp opens from July to mid-November, so guests can see this remarkable event with their own eyes. Facilities are of a high standard, with eight tents (one of them a family tent) offering ensuite flush toilets, hot water, 24-hour solar power and lovely views over the savannah. To round off exciting safari days in a relaxed way, there is a dining tent, a lounge and a bar with a fireplace.
